_meta.description: REAL ground truth for the 2022 Chao Phraya (NORU) flood — GISTDA satellite flood-area analysis (28 Sep - 14 Oct 2022), published via thaiwater.net. Replaces the earlier fixture gold. Used by src/ingest/fixtures.py to set GOLD_FLOODED.
_meta.source_note: GISTDA satellite analysis; total 8,067,730 rai across 53 provinces. This is the D3 ground truth the project targeted — obtained via thaiwater's published GISTDA product because disaster.gistda.or.th STAC API is unreachable (see Bugs).

corroboration.provinces: Chai Nat, Sing Buri, Ang Thong, Ayutthaya, Pathum Thani, Nonthaburi district-level flooding

_meta.cutoff_rationale: gold = provinces with GISTDA flooded area >= 10,000 rai (~16 km2) = provincially-significant flooding. Sub-threshold provinces recorded but excluded from gold; sensitivity noted in README.

diff_vs_fixture.note: Real GISTDA data adds upstream provinces (Tak, Phitsanulok) that flooded from local rain — which the reservoir-centric graph cannot reach — and drops Pathum Thani (only 3,190 rai, below cutoff). Nonthaburi flooded only 38 rai (negligible).
